mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, i.name AS industry, c.company_scale AS scale, c.business_number, c.representative_name AS representative, c.founded_on, c.business_type, c.business_item, c.representative_phone, c.representative_email, c.operation_status, c.created_at FROM companies c JOIN industry_types i ON c.industry_code = i.code WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE companies SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), company_scale = COALESCE(#{scale}, company_scale), business_number = COALESCE(#{businessNumber}, business_number), representative_name = COALESCE(#{representative}, representative_name), founded_on = COALESCE(#{foundedOn}, founded_on), business_type = COALESCE(#{businessType}, business_type), business_item = COALESCE(#{businessItem}, business_item), representative_phone = COALESCE(#{representativePhone}, representative_phone), representative_email = COALESCE(#{representativeEmail}, representative_email), operation_status = COALESCE(#{operationStatus}, operation_status) WHERE id = #{id}
